description: This file defines a utility class 'ParamChecker' with static methods for parameter validation, including null checks, emptiness checks, and bit validation, used for input validation within the project.

classes.name: ParamChecker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for parameter validation such as null checks, emptiness checks, and bit validation.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Checks if the provided object is not null; throws IllegalArgumentException if null.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Overloaded methods to check if String, Object array, Collection, or Map are not null or empty.

methods.name: checkGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Checks if an integer parameter is greater than zero.

methods.name: checkBit
methods.description: Validates that a bit value is between 0 and 7 inclusive.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if the String, Collection, or Map is null or empty.

methods.name: isValidBit
methods.description: Checks if an integer is within the valid bit range (0-7).
